issues.description: The UML in the problem statement declares the SealSaloon attribute totalOrders as type int, but the solution implementation uses a long for totalOrders. This mismatch can confuse students about which numeric type to use when implementing the attribute and its getter, and may lead to inconsistent implementations or failing type expectations in tests or grading code.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the type consistent across the artifacts. Either update the problem statement / UML to indicate totalOrders: long, or change the solution implementation to use an int for totalOrders and adjust its getter accordingly. Ensure any tests or examples use the same type.
